CARES PostgreSQL Round 3.2 — Implementation Authorization Matrix (Round 3.2.1 Fidelity-Corrected)

Status: Proposed governance/authorization-control record only; NOT IMPLEMENTED, NOT TESTED, NOT AN IMPLEMENTATION AUTHORIZATION.
Round: Round 3.2 — Owner Decision Consolidation and Governance Reconciliation; Round 3.2.1 — Owner Decision Fidelity Correction (documentation/governance only).
Verified source baseline: governance/postgresql-round3-2-owner-decision-consolidation @ cd950882b0ea0e58781d9ba8f10440bd383f9b58.
Working branch: governance/postgresql-round3-2-1-owner-decision-fidelity-correction (from verified source commit).

1. Purpose and controlling rule

This matrix reconciles implementation readiness/authorization posture for I-00–I-14 against the Round 3.2.1 fidelity-corrected, authoritative owner-approved principles and bounded conditions for OD-001–OD-013 (see POSTGRESQL_ROUND3_2_OWNER_DECISION_REGISTER.md). It explicitly distinguishes:

  1. Owner-approved principles (bounded conditions approved in principle; authoritative as recorded),
  2. Technically unresolved details (not approved, not finalized),
  3. Planning-ready increments (planning/preparation only, no execution authorization implied),
  4. Blocked increments (cannot be safely authorized/executed due to unresolved prerequisites/validations/approvals),
  5. Explicitly authorized implementation increments, if any (only with a separate, explicit owner authorization record satisfying required prerequisites).

Controlling rule (no accidental implementation): No implementation is authorized by this correction task. Owner approval of OD-001–OD-013 principles/bounded conditions does not authorize I-06, I-07, I-09, I-12, I-13, I-14, or any other implementation increment. Conditional readiness or planning recommendations do not convert to permission to implement. Any implementation requires a separate, explicit owner authorization record per increment/scope with satisfied prerequisites, approvals, validations, evidence, and exclusions.

2. Evidence checked (authorization records)

  • Governance artifacts reviewed: Round 3.2/3.1 implementation plans, readiness/blocker matrices, dependency maps, authorization templates, and this Round 3.2.1 corrected package.
  • Explicit owner authorization records found: None. No completed, separately executed implementation authorization record exists for any I-00–I-14 increment.

3. Preserved boundaries

  • PD-001–PD-012: unresolved/deferred wherever recorded in baseline (not closed by OD principle approvals).
  • ADR 0006: formal status remains Proposed; OD-001 records acceptance in principle with bounded conditions/dependencies (not unconditional formal acceptance).
  • I-00–I-14: boundaries and dependencies preserved/reconciled without silently widening scope.
